apprace.msg.101: A white woman, one of the fairer half of surviving humanity.

appstyle.msg.101: You wear your black hair in a bob, like half the women in the Vault - it suits any face and flatters just about everyone. The clothing synthesizer glitched and you ended up with jumpsuit number 13.
Your silky fair hair has always been the most talked-about in the Vault. Some say blondes are stupid - you disagree. The clothing synthesizer glitched and you ended up with jumpsuit number 13.
Some say red hair means you have no soul. But when you look this good, who needs one? The clothing synthesizer glitched and you ended up with jumpsuit number 13.

Your bright green mohawk says everything anyone needs to know about your temperament. Plenty of people in the Vault dislike you. You could not care less. The clothing synthesizer glitched and you ended up with jumpsuit number 13.

apprace.msg.101: A white man, one of the stronger half of surviving humanity.

appstyle.msg.101: Plain short hair. Nothing about you stands out, and you have no patience for fashion or any of that nonsense. The clothing synthesizer glitched and you ended up with jumpsuit number 13.
You have magnificent long hair. Half the Vault would kill for a mane like that - the women especially. The clothing synthesizer glitched and you ended up with jumpsuit number 13.
Bald, you look hard enough that most of the Vault gives you room - the Overseer included. The clothing synthesizer glitched and you ended up with jumpsuit number 13.

apprace.msg.101: A black man, one of the stronger half of surviving humanity.

appstyle.msg.101: Your long black hair looks like it has not seen water in months. Then again, it might just be the style. The clothing synthesizer glitched and you ended up with jumpsuit number 13.

apprace.msg.101: A black man, one of the stronger half of surviving humanity.

appstyle.msg.101: A short, no-frills cut. At the very least, nobody is going to grab you by the hair. The clothing synthesizer glitched and you ended up with jumpsuit number 13.

appracepm.msg.101: Humans, inhabitants of the planet Earth, survivors of the Great War of 2077. Many took shelter in the vaults, but most remained on the surface to face the aftermath of the nuclear catastrophe.
appracepm.msg.201: Super mutants arose from radioactive contamination and exposure to the FEV virus, developed before the Great War to accelerate regeneration and remake human DNA.
appracepm.msg.301: Walking dead who once had human form. Heavy radiation exposure changed their flesh, but left their minds intact.
appracepm.msg.401: Domesticated two-headed cattle with eight stomachs. Widely used as pack animals for hauling cargo, and as a source of meat.
appracepm.msg.501: Mechanical beings built before the Great War to handle household chores and security work.
appracepm.msg.601: Man's four-legged friends, who survived the nuclear catastrophe with their loyalty and courage intact.
appracepm.msg.701: Terrifying monsters, spawn of the atomic fire. They stand around six meters tall, and the teeth in their shark-like jaws can be the size of a human arm.

appstylepm.msg.101: A stocky warrior with a bone through his nose. His appearance reflects years of survival in the post-apocalyptic wastes.
appstylepm.msg.121: A cybernetic dog, half metal and half living flesh.
